question: Where was the 1st Indian Film Festival held in the United States?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Seattle**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• 1st Indian Film Festival begins in US, showcasing PM Modi’s vision.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **1st Indian Film Festival** took place in **Seattle**, United States, marking the beginning of a **three-day celebration of Indian cinema**.

 
 
• 
 
The event was held at the **Museum of Pop Culture** and featured **excerpts from Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s podcast** with **Lex Fridman**, focusing on the **“Idea of India”**.

 
 
• 
 
The festival was attended by notable dignitaries such as **US Congresswoman Pramila Jayapal**, **King County Council Member Sarah Perry**, and **Seattle Port Commissioner Sam Cho**.
